title: SWAP5 Module Contract Standard & Replaceability Governance

final_live_recheck.meaning: F-CI57 fail-closed mass-completeness transaction gate admitted after branch start; moving canonical did not alter F-RG01D policy semantics

standard_effect.module_definition: architectural responsibility with a stable semantic boundary, not a one-to-one source-file or Fortran-module identity
standard_effect.manifest_role: compact contract capsule and authority index; never a second source of detailed technical truth
standard_effect.prospective_rule: new modules and material module-contract changes must establish/update a schema-conforming manifest before production admission
standard_effect.historical_rule: already-admitted modules are not invalidated; migrate at next material contract change or bounded consolidation workunit
standard_effect.parallelism_bridge: provided/consumed contracts and frozen/moving status operationalize the F-RG01A semantic-ownership gate
standard_effect.recovery_bridge: module contract version and changed contracts become part of F-RG01B recoverable checkpoints
standard_effect.replaceability_rule: replacement is semantic: stable state/transaction/conservation/time/failure contracts must hold while unrelated consumers remain unchanged

initial_registry.interpretation: This is an adoption baseline only. Existing production maturity is not downgraded.
initial_registry.strong_existing_exemplar: F-SI31 SoilWaterSolverResearchContract v1.0.0, research-scoped and not a production ABI replacement

recommended_initial_consolidation_order: soil-water solver interface and Full Richards implementation boundary
